components.css: .ds-plate { display: flex; flex-direction: column; color: #241c18; text-decoration: none; background: #faf6f1; border: 1px solid rgba(36, 28, 24, 0.08); border-radius: 4px 22px 4px 22px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) inset, 0 14px 32px rgba(72, 42, 32, 0.06); transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-plate:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8) inset, 2px 22px 44px rgba(72, 42, 32, 0.12); } .ds-plate:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--mark, #7a3140); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-plate-image { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; background: #efe6dc; } .ds-plate-copy { display: flex; flex: 1; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 16px 18px; } .ds-plate-title { font-family: "Songti SC", "STSong", "Noto Serif SC", "Iowan Old Style", Palatino, serif; font-size: 22px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-plate-blurb { color: #4e433d; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-plate-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-top: auto; padding-top: 12px; font-family: "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Avenir Next", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-plate-meta b { color: #4e433d; font-weight: 560; font-style: normal; } .ds-plate-meta em { color: var(--mark); font-style: normal; font-weight: 560; }

narrative.overview:
The catalog is one desk of ivory paper with nine equal mounted plates. Nothing is featured above the rest; the visitor reads a short title and instruction, then chooses exactly one plate. Titles sit in Songti; body copy stays in a system sans. Each plate carries a 4:3 still-life illustration and a single sentence. The only colored accent on a plate is the word 进入, tinted with that plate’s mark.

This system documents the catalog page (`index.html` / `css/home.css`) and the shared paper tokens it actually declares. Individual assessment apps keep their own stylesheets; their question-runner UI is out of scope here.
keyCharacteristics: Equal plates in a fixed order; no hero plate and no leftover list
Ivory paper desk, warmer sheet surfaces, ink-brown type
Songti for page and plate titles; sans for body, blurbs, and meta
Still-life images locked to 4:3 and mounted on the plate
Per-plate `--mark` color appears only on 进入 (and focus outline when set)

rules.name: The Enter-Only Mark Rule
rules.body: A plate’s mark color may tint 进入 and the focus outline. It must not wash the title, blurb, meta counts, border, or illustration frame.

rules.name: The Equal Plate Rule
rules.body: No plate receives a larger accent, badge, or featured treatment. Mark color does not create hierarchy between plates.

rules.name: The Songti Title Rule
rules.body: Songti is reserved for the page title and plate titles. Blurbs, meta, lead, and close stay sans.

rules.name: The Three-Then-Collapse Rule
rules.body: Desktop shows three equal columns so the first viewport can hold three full plates under the title. Narrower viewports collapse to two, then one — never a featured row plus a remnant list.

rules.name: The Mounted Plate Rule
rules.body: Shadows describe paper resting on the desk. Do not add hard offset drop-shadows, glow, or layered card stacks.

rules.name: The Folio Corner Rule
rules.body: Keep the 4 / 22 / 4 / 22 radius on catalog plates. Do not round all corners equally or pill the plate.

dos: Do keep all nine plates equal in size, structure, and chrome.
Do put each plate’s mark color only on 进入 (and focus when that plate is targeted).
Do lock still lifes to 4:3 and mount them at the top of the plate.
Do use Songti for titles and sans for body, blurb, meta, and close.
Do collapse the grid 3 → 2 → 1 without introducing a featured hero.
donts: Don't feature one assessment above the others or demote the rest into a leftover list.
Don't spread mark color across titles, blurbs, borders, or image frames.
Don't replace folio corners with uniform large radii or pill shapes.
Don't fold scl90 / pdq / ecr question-runner chrome into this catalog system.
Don't add kickers, eyebrows, floating badges, or stat strips to the first viewport.
